segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Hi Dana, thanks for making time. I saw your note about starting with the operations team only, so I wanted to walk through seats, timing, and the first invoice before we send the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Yeah, that sounds good. We’re looking at 38 seats for launch, with maybe another 12 in Q2 if the rollout goes well.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Okay, 38 seats. On the annual plan that comes to $31,920 for the year, and implementation is the one-time $4,500 fee we discussed. Does that still line up with what finance approved?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: It does. They approved up to $37,000 all-in for year one, so we’re inside that. They’ll want net 30 and the invoice dated after February 1.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Yep, we can do net 30, and I’ll set the billing start date as February 1. For go-live, are you still targeting March 18?

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: March 18 is still the date. We’d need admin training the week of February 19, then manager training the first week of March.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: That works. We’ll include two admin sessions and one manager session in the implementation package. If you need a second manager session, it’s $750, but we can decide that later.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Okay. Contract term is 12 months, right? No auto-renewal longer than one year.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Correct, 12-month initial term, then it renews annually unless either side gives 30 days’ notice. I’ll make sure that’s clear in the order form.

segments.speaker: Customer
segments.text: Great. Send it to me and copy Marcus in procurement. If it matches what we covered, I can get signature by Friday.

segments.speaker: Rep
segments.text: Perfect. I’ll send it over this afternoon with the seat count, February 1 billing date, and March 18 go-live. Thanks, Dana.
